caption: The drawing depicts two detailed views of a metal door lock mechanism. The upper view shows the exterior of the rectangular lock box, which has a metallic, greyish-silver color, four visible screw holes at the corners, a keyhole located near the bottom center, and a handle or lever attached to the top. Two thick, rectangular bolts protrude from the right side. The lower view shows the same lock with the front cover removed, exposing the internal mechanical components, including gears, levers, and a coiled spring, all rendered in shades of grey, metallic tones, and some light brownish areas indicating wear or shadow. To the right of the opened lock mechanism is a separate rectangular metal strike plate with two square holes and two round screw holes, also in a grey metallic color. The background is a plain, light beige.
title: Wrought Iron Lock
